name: modern-open-youth-M1008
finalText:
I opened a Youth sub-account for member M-1008 (Daria Petrenko), and the site confirmed it.

- **Member ID:** M-1008
- **Selected account type:** Youth
- **Confirmation status:** Successful. The page said "Sub-account M-1008-S1 (Youth) opened for Daria Petrenko. Simulated — no real transaction."

Before I acted, the customer page showed her main account as Savings with a $1,299.99 balance and "Sub-accounts: none". I read the page text before each step and again after the confirmation appeared. I didn't go back to the customer page afterward, so I haven't checked that M-1008-S1 is listed there.
